name: DPM++ 2M SDE (midpoint)
plain: The 2M idea with a noise term: an exponential update on x0 in half-logSNR, a second-order correction from the previous x0, and Brownian noise. Default solver_type midpoint. η=0 removes the noise. One model call per step.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
λ=half-logSNR, h=λ'−λ, h_η=h(1+η), r=h_last/h, α'=σ'e^{λ'}.
x'=(σ'/σ)e^{−hη}x+α'(1−e^{−h_η})D.
From step 2: x'+=½α'(1−e^{−h_η})(1/r)(D−D_old).
If η,s_noise>0: x'+=n(σ,σ')·σ'·√(1−e^{−2hη})·s_noise.

props.flow_const: half-logSNR via sigma_to_half_log_snr: λ=−log σ normally, λ=log((1−σ)/σ) on CONST; α=σe^{λ} (1 normally, 1−σ on CONST). First σ≥1 on CONST replaced by percent_to_sigma(1e-4); s_noise×noise_scale.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Same algorithm; the _gpu name differs only by building the BrownianTreeNoiseSampler with cpu=False, so the noise tensor values differ for one seed. Node has solver_type midpoint or heun, eta, s_noise, noise_device; gpu is listed first.
